turns.said: I have multiple sclerosis and some days I can't type for long.
turns.reply:
You said some days you can't type for long.

Here are some things that might help:

An alternative or ergonomic keyboard. This is shaped or laid out to make typing easier or less painful.
An anti-glare filter or screen dimming. This takes the glare off your screen, which can make a long day possible.
Speech-to-text software. This types what you say so you do not have to use a keyboard.

You can stop here if you just wanted to know what is out there. If you want help asking for one of these, I can help with that too. Would you like to talk about any of these options?
